# Oral Surgeon in Westwood, CA


Home › Areas We Serve › Oral Surgeon in Westwood, CA

Westwood is one of the most distinctive neighborhoods on the Westside of Los Angeles, shaped by the University of California, Los Angeles campus, the charming pedestrian retail of Westwood Village, and the upscale residential corridors that connect it to Beverly Hills and Bel-Air. Whether you are a student, a faculty member, a longtime resident in the Wilshire Corridor condos, or a professional commuting through Century City, Wilshire Oral Surgery and Implant Center is minutes away at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326, Los Angeles, CA 90025. From most of Westwood, the drive east along Wilshire Boulevard takes under ten minutes, making our practice one of the most accessible oral surgery offices for Westwood patients.

Our practice is led by two fellowship-trained, board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeons. You can learn more about our team and what sets our surgeons apart.

Dr. Jonathan R. Shadi, DDS

B.S. Neuroscience, UCLA · DDS, USC School of Dentistry · Dean’s List · John Ingle Research Award (2009) · OMFS Internship, Veterans’ Affairs Hospital

Dr. Saman Vahedi, DDS

B.S. Molecular Biology, UCLA · DDS, Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry USC · OMFS Residency, University of Nebraska Medical Center · Chief Resident 2013–2014 · Diplomate, American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons


## Oral Surgery Procedures We Offer Westwood Patients


We offer a full range of oral and maxillofacial surgery services for Westwood patients across all stages of life. Whether your need is preventive, restorative, or reconstructive, our team is equipped with the technology and training to provide exceptional care.

Tooth Extractions

Safe removal of impacted or problematic teeth, with IV sedation available.

Permanent, natural-looking tooth replacement for single or multiple missing teeth.

Restoring jawbone density to support implants or address bone loss.

Comprehensive treatment planning for extensive tooth loss or damage.

Advanced on-site imaging for precise surgical planning.

IV Sedation & Anesthesia

Comfortable, monitored sedation options administered by our surgeons.

Orthognathic Surgery

Corrective jaw surgery for functional and alignment concerns.

Oral Pathology & Biopsies

Diagnosis and evaluation of unusual lesions or abnormalities.

Surgical exposure to guide teeth into proper position.

Facial Trauma & Fractures

Treatment for injuries to the jaw, cheekbones, and surrounding structures.


## What to Expect on Your First Visit


We understand that oral surgery can feel daunting, and we work to make your first visit as comfortable and informative as possible. Here is how a typical consultation unfolds at our Wilshire Boulevard office.

Arrival & Intake

You are greeted and guided through your intake. Complete patient registration online in advance to save time.

Imaging

Your surgeon evaluates your condition using our in-house Cone Beam 3D imaging — no outside referral needed.

Consultation

Your surgeon reviews your history, discusses sedation preferences, answers your questions, and walks you through all options.

Your Treatment Plan

You leave with a clear plan and full confidence in your care team — no pressure, no surprises.


## Why Westwood Patients Choose Wilshire Oral Surgery and Implant Center


Westwood patients have UCLA’s own dental school nearby, yet many choose to travel just a few minutes east to our office on Wilshire Boulevard. Our practice offers a combination of board-level credentials, advanced technology, and personalized attention that is difficult to find in a single practice.

Dual Board-Certified Surgeons

Both Dr. Shadi and Dr. Vahedi hold credentials from the American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons, reflecting the highest standard in the field.

In-House Cone Beam 3D Imaging

Precise, low-radiation imaging completed on-site, eliminating referrals and delays.

Full Sedation Options

Our surgeons administer IV sedation and general anesthesia in-office for anxious patients and complex procedures.

Westside Location

Our office at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326 sits directly along the corridor connecting Westwood to the rest of West Los Angeles.

Comprehensive Scope of Care

From routine extractions to full arch reconstruction and jaw surgery — one practice, no multiple referrals.

Ready to Schedule Your Consultation?

Dr. Shadi and Dr. Vahedi provide personalized treatment plans at Wilshire Oral Surgery and Implant Center, serving Westwood and the surrounding Westside. We also serve patients from Century City and Brentwood, and you can view all the communities we serve across the Westside.

The cost of oral surgery varies based on the procedure, complexity, and whether sedation is involved. We believe cost should never be a barrier to getting the care you need, which is why we offer multiple options to fit different financial situations. Our team reviews your insurance coverage prior to your appointment and provides a clear breakdown of any expected out-of-pocket costs.

For patients without insurance or those requiring procedures not covered by their plan, we offer flexible payment options to help spread costs over time. You can also review our insurance and financing information online before your visit. We work with a wide range of PPO dental insurance plans and are happy to answer questions about coverage during your consultation.


## Frequently Asked Questions From Westwood Patients


How far is Wilshire Oral Surgery from Westwood?

Our office is located at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326, Los Angeles, CA 90025. From central Westwood, the drive east along Wilshire Boulevard typically takes under ten minutes depending on traffic. Patients can also reach us via Gayley Avenue heading south to Wilshire or via Santa Monica Boulevard.

Do you offer sedation for oral surgery procedures?

Yes. Our surgeons are trained and licensed to administer IV sedation and general anesthesia in-office. We offer sedation for wisdom tooth removal, dental implant placement, bone grafting, and other procedures where patients prefer a more comfortable experience or where the complexity of the case warrants it.

What is the difference between an oral surgeon and a general dentist?

Oral and maxillofacial surgeons complete four to six years of hospital-based surgical residency training after dental school, giving them advanced skills in anesthesia, complex extractions, implant surgery, jaw surgery, and facial trauma. General dentists may perform basic extractions and simple implant placements, but cases with significant complexity, bone loss, or sedation requirements are typically referred to a specialist like our surgeons.

Do I need a referral from my dentist to schedule an appointment?

No referral is required to schedule a consultation at Wilshire Oral Surgery and Implant Center. Many patients contact us directly after identifying a concern or receiving an initial recommendation from their dentist. If your dentist has provided X-rays or records, we encourage you to bring them to your first appointment.

How long is recovery after wisdom tooth removal?

Recovery after wisdom tooth extraction typically involves two to four days of rest, with most patients returning to normal activity within a week. Swelling and mild discomfort are common in the first 48 to 72 hours. We provide detailed post-operative instructions and are available to answer any questions that arise during your recovery.

Does insurance cover oral surgery?

Many dental and medical insurance plans provide at least partial coverage for oral surgery procedures, particularly when they are medically necessary. Wisdom tooth removal, biopsies, bone grafts related to trauma, and certain implant cases may be covered. We review your specific plan before your appointment and provide a clear explanation of what is covered. Visit our insurance and financing page for more information.


## Schedule Your Consultation — Serving Westwood and the Westside


Dr. Shadi and Dr. Vahedi bring board-level oral surgery credentials and years of hands-on surgical experience to every patient at Wilshire Oral Surgery and Implant Center. Whether you need a single extraction or are exploring implants and jaw surgery, our team takes the time to understand your goals and build a treatment plan around your anatomy, timeline, and budget. We serve patients throughout the Westside from our office at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326, Los Angeles, CA 90025.

To take the first step, request an appointment online or call us at (310) 846-8978. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you understand your options.
